name: Member Search Criteria 4
definition: Defines the criteria used to search for a member.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of a member within a system, assigned using the member identification scheme of the system.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Nature of the relationship a member has with a system.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Status of a member in a system, such as enabled or deleted.
